title: Warranty - Laptops
text:
This warranty covers laptops bought from our store, whether you ordered online or bought in person. Laptops are covered for 1 year from the date of purchase against defects in materials and workmanship, and the cover begins on the day shown on your proof of purchase. The cover is the same whatever the screen size, processor or colour of the laptop.

What the warranty covers

The warranty covers the parts the laptop was sold with: the screen, the keyboard and touchpad, the battery, the ports, the main board, the memory and storage, the fans, and the charger that came in the box. Typical covered faults are keys that stop working, a screen with dead lines or a flickering backlight, ports that no longer connect, a fan that makes a grinding noise, and a laptop that will not start although it has not been dropped or wet. Pre-installed software that fails because of a hardware fault is restored as part of the repair. Coverage applies to normal use at home, at work or at school.

What the warranty does not cover

The warranty does not cover accidental damage such as drops, spills and cracked screens, or cosmetic wear such as scratches, dents and worn keys. It does not cover software problems, viruses or lost files, faults caused by parts or accessories that did not come with the laptop, or damage from repairs made by anyone other than an approved service center. A battery slowly holds less charge as it ages; that is normal, and it is covered only when the battery fails outright. Damage from heat, such as a laptop left in a hot car, is not covered.

How to make a claim

To make a claim, contact our customer service team online or visit the service desk in one of our stores with your proof of purchase. Describe the fault and, if the laptop still starts, run the built-in hardware check and note any error code it shows. The team may guide you through a few steps by phone or chat first, because many faults turn out to be settings or software that can be fixed without sending the laptop anywhere. Keep a note of the claim number we give you and quote it whenever you contact us.

Repair, replacement or refund

If the claim is accepted, the laptop is repaired, either at a service desk or through a prepaid mail-in service, and returned to you when the repair is done. If it cannot be repaired, it is replaced with the same or a comparable laptop, and a refund is offered only when neither is possible. Copy your files before you hand the laptop over, because a repair can erase the storage drive, and remove any discs or memory cards you added. A mail-in repair comes with a padded box and a prepaid label, so you do not need to find packing yourself.

Proof of purchase and transfer

Keep your proof of purchase for as long as the laptop is covered, because it shows when the cover started. If you bought online with your account, our team can find the sale there if the proof is lost. The warranty stays with the laptop if you give it away or sell it, and the next owner can make a claim with the original proof of purchase. If the laptop was a gift, the person who received it can claim with a gift receipt.
